meta.description: Exposes Reckons.AI capture as an MCP server on your n8n, so any MCP client — a phone app, a note-taking ring's companion app, another agent — can drop a note into your graph without ever reaching your laptop.

parameters.content:
## What this is

```
Phone/ring app ──MCP──▶ n8n (your VPS)
                            │ tool: capture_note
                            ▼
                  /webhook/reckons-note
                            │
                            ▼
                     Google Drive
                            │
        Reckons.AI ◀──poll──┘
```

The MCP client never talks to your machine. It calls a **tool**; n8n does the work; Reckons.AI pulls.

## Setup order matters

1. Deploy and configure **Reckons — iOS Note Capture** FIRST. This workflow calls its webhook; without it, `capture_note` returns a 404 and the MCP client reports success anyway.
2. Set `CAPTURE_WEBHOOK_URL` on the capture_note node to that workflow's production URL.
3. Set **Bearer auth** on the trigger below and give the token to the app.
4. Activate. The production MCP URL appears on the trigger node.

## Why a separate workflow

The MCP trigger only connects to tool nodes — it cannot contain the capture logic itself. Pointing the tool at the existing webhook also means the capture path stays ONE tested implementation, rather than a second copy that drifts.

## Bearer auth is not optional

This endpoint is on the public internet and its tool WRITES into your knowledge graph. Anyone holding the URL and no token should get nothing.

## Notes arrive PENDING

The capture webhook writes rows the app imports as **pending facts**, never confirmed ones. That is deliberate and it matters more here than anywhere else in the product: the writer is a speech-to-text transcript on the far side of the internet, which is exactly where a misheard name becomes a confident triple.

An MCP tool that could confirm facts directly would be a remote write path into an authoritative graph. This one cannot.

parameters.toolDescription: Capture a short note into the user's Reckons.AI knowledge graph. Use this for anything the user says they want to remember, ask about later, or follow up on — a task, an observation, a name, a deadline. Pass the note EXACTLY as the user said it. Do not summarise, rephrase, expand abbreviations, or correct what sounds like a mistake: the wording is the record, and interpreting it is a separate step a human reviews. Returns confirmation that the note was queued.

values.name: input
values.description: The note, verbatim as the user said it.
